note: London is framed week on week and year on year rather than against target: the FY26/27 weekly targets were set before the Shard's traffic shift and the Dim Sum Library rebrand, so variance to them is not a clean read, and DSL is flagged not comparable for the same reason. London booked 3,140 GA4 bookings, up 1.1 percent week on week and down 4.2 percent year on year, against a weekly target of 3,776 carried here for reference only. The year-on-year gap is again entirely Aqua Shard, which is 548 bookings below last year, four times the whole London shortfall of 137; the other five venues together are up 27.7 percent year on year. Hutong booked 1,004, its best week since late August, exactly level with its target and up 12.9 percent week on week. Regent St is the one to watch, down 19.9 percent week on week and 30.9 percent year on year on traffic 45.6 percent below last year. Conversion still reads better than traffic: it is above last year at Hutong, Regent St, Shiro Sushi and DSL, a little below at Azzurra, and well down only at Aqua Shard, 4.7 percent against 6.6 percent. Covers are reported alongside these figures because total_payment is unreliable in London and GA4 cannot see OpenTable.
